# Ignitify tenant harness

> Knowledge for AI clients that work with Ignitify through the `ignitify` CLI: the platform, task authoring, deploys, runs, observation, troubleshooting, limits and cost. Tenant level only. Ignitify makes no model calls for the client; the client uses its own model.

Start with skills/ignitify-getting-started/SKILL.md. The installed CLI is the authority: `ignitify help <command>`.

## Skills

- [Getting started](skills/ignitify-getting-started/SKILL.md): what Ignitify is, install, sign in, a read-only key for the AI client, safety rules for AI clients
- [Task authoring](skills/ignitify-task-authoring/SKILL.md): task.yaml, runtimes, ctx API, execution nature, network, system packages, upload rules
- [Deploy](skills/ignitify-deploy/SKILL.md): validate, pack, deploy, deployment status, versions, build failures
- [Runs](skills/ignitify-runs/SKILL.md): task:run flags, run status, safe retries with --idempotency-key, schedules, webhooks, notify, cancel, flows built from runs
- [Secrets](skills/ignitify-secrets/SKILL.md): declare names, the user sets values, ctx.secrets
- [Terraform](skills/ignitify-terraform/SKILL.md): the Ignitify provider, owner key versus user key, resources, write-only secrets, import, CLI instead
- [Integrations](skills/ignitify-integrations/SKILL.md): integration:add for Node tasks
- [Observe](skills/ignitify-observe/SKILL.md): run:get, run:logs, run:timeline, run:failures, --json
- [Troubleshooting](skills/ignitify-troubleshooting/SKILL.md): diagnosis flow, failure patterns, before contacting support
- [Error catalogue](skills/ignitify-troubleshooting/errors.md): every tenant error line (limits, access, idempotency, builds), meaning and fix
- [Support report template](skills/ignitify-troubleshooting/support-report.md)
- [Limits and cost](skills/ignitify-limits-and-cost/SKILL.md): whoami, quota, usage, presets, what costs more
- [CLI reference](skills/ignitify-cli-reference/SKILL.md): every command (with access control), flag, exit code, and who may run it

## Templates and examples

- [task.yaml starters](templates/task-yaml/): node.yaml, python.yaml, go.yaml, rust.yaml
- [node-github-stars](examples/node-github-stars/): outbound network with an allow list
- [python-word-stats](examples/python-word-stats/): no network, input checks
- [go-checksum](examples/go-checksum/): Go task code on top of the scaffold
- [rust-countdown](examples/rust-countdown/): progress chunks with interaction: continuous
